newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 ends higher, near day's best levels.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 ends higher, near day's best levels.

text.p: The FTSE 100 continued to reclaim some of the ground lost in recent weeks, but traders and strategists say further gains are likely to be limited until the UK budget is released on November 26.

"Cash levels are very high at the moment, but I don't think anyone is going to be comfortable putting it into the market this side of the budget," said Tim Russell, head of UK equities at Lazard Investors.
Buoyed by a firm gilt market and a strong performance on Wall Street overnight, the UK benchmark blue chip index climbed 19.9 points to settle at 3,934.3, near the day's best level.
